name: Sam, We Talked About This
storyline: Sam runs a one-room AI startup with a single computer and a mouse. He scrapes the internet page by page, trains models on whatever he finds, and publishes those models to a growing crowd of subscribers. The money buys bigger machines, more storage and a crew that takes the dirty work off his hands. The room fills with hardware, the models climb from text to images to video, and the internet itself starts running out of pages to take. At the end of the road waits a superintelligence, and a room where nobody is left to say that they talked about this.
summary: Sam, We Talked About This is an idle incremental game. Scrape whatever the internet has, train AI models on it, let the models pull in subscribers and turn them into cash. Put the cash into more disks, bigger machines and a bigger crew. The loop feeds itself and speeds up, and the models keep getting smarter. AGI is waiting at the end.
